name: Frame clock
responsibility: The clock that motion reads: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything (driveFramesFrom). Its stepped clock also takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It stands every animation at the frame's time. An animation on a timeline it cannot stand is a violation. The picture stage asks it for its frames and reads its time, so a replay steps the canvas too. A lint rule keeps the viewer on it rather than on the browser's timers.
